Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.chat

package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.chat
Chat bounded context — application layer.

Carries:

  • the provider-agnostic LlmChatClient port and its companion records (ChatRequest, ChatChunk, ChatResult, ChatMessage, Role, SamplingParameters) — US-09-001;
  • the conversation lifecycle use cases — start (US-10-005), and the read / edit-title / delete / list-messages variants that follow it (US-10-006 .. US-10-010).

EPIC-11's SendMessageService and EPIC-12's DelegationService land alongside these classes as their stories come online.

    AgentConfigurationDriftException
    Raised when an agent's persisted configuration references a tool or MCP server that no longer exists in its catalog at chat-turn time.
    ChatChunk
    One incremental fragment of a streamed assistant response (design §12).
    ChatMessage

    ChatRequest
    Provider-agnostic LLM chat-completion request (design §12).
    ChatRequestBuilder
    Translates Agent + memory window into a ChatRequest ready for LlmChatClient (US-11-003).
    ChatResult
    Non-streaming LLM result (design §12).
    ChatTurnContext
    Per-turn context bag carrying the parent agent id and parent owner so the Spring AI tool callback (US-12-003 DelegateTool) can resolve "which chat turn am I running in" without depending on SendMessageService or threading a context object through every Spring AI tool layer.
    DelegationService
    Application-layer port driving the delegate(...) capability of EPIC-12 (REQ-AGT-011, REQ-AGT-013, REQ-AGT-015).

    TurnEvent
    Typed in-process event emitted by SendMessageUseCase.send(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.chat.SendMessageUseCase.SendMessageCommand) for one chat turn (design §7.1).
    TurnEvent.Completed
    Emitted exactly once at successful end of turn, after the ASSISTANT message has been persisted.
    TurnEvent.Delta
    One incremental fragment of the assistant's reply.
    TurnEvent.Error
    Sanitized error payload for SSE-side translation.
    TurnEvent.Started
    Emitted exactly once, after the USER message has been persisted (US-11-004 step 2).
